author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
Huge Thanks to Ayham for hosting us through Iraq. If you are interested in Iraq travel check out his Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ayhamf.j?igsh=amhjNmprcXJvcTA3

After exploring Baghdad, we decided to head deeper into rural Iraq. In a small village about four hours from the capital, we met two friends of Ayham who welcomed us into their community. When we walked through the village marketplace, word spread quickly, within minutes hundreds of people had gathered to meet us. People were incredibly warm and curious, asking questions, taking photos, and even gifting us sweets, fruits, and other treats. It was one of those moments that reminds you how powerful genuine human connection can be.
From there we continued our road trip to the ancient city of Babylon, once one of the great centers of civilization in Mesopotamia. Today the ruins sit in a peaceful landscape, watched over by one of Saddam Hussein’s many palaces, which he built on a hill overlooking the historic site. Interes
title: Things Got WILD in Rural Iraq 🇮🇶 I S3, EP33
